newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Milosevic ready to adopt democracy plan, diplomats.
newsitem.headline: Milosevic ready to adopt democracy plan, diplomats.

text.p: European Union diplomats said on Tuesday the Serbian government was ready to accept the recommendations of an OSCE report calling for President Slobodan Milosevic to recognise local election results.

The head of the delegation, the Dutch embassy's first secretary Menno Lenstra said the meeting was positive, and that he understood the Serbian government was looking for ways to implement the recommendations of the report by the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE)
"We expressed our concern about the situation and urged the authorities to act upon the recomendations, and we got the impression they are doing that," Lenstra told Reuters.
The EU delegation met Nikola Cicanovic, deputy foreign minister of Serbian-led Yugoslavia, after failing to win an audience either with Milosevic or Yugoslav Foreign Minister Milan Milutinovic.

Their delegation was the latest in a series of Western attempts to push Milosevic into accepting the results of November 17 local elections which the opposition won and which was later annulled over alleged "irregularities".
